
        <h2 class="post-title">
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hy-lavender/p/20600645" title="发布于 2026-06-17 14:50">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">IDEA的AI Assistant—Codex初始化失败、Node初始化失败：Failed to initialize ACP session. Error: Process cancelled、Reconnecting...</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>这两天开始接触到IDEA自带的ai chat，发现开通了他的AI Pro会员后，可以免费使用三种智能体，Codex、Claude Agent、Junie，而总是提示acp 初始化失败，一共遇到两种错误。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">问题1、Node的npm初始化失败</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to initialize ACP session. Error: Process cancelled</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to initialize ACP process. Process terminated with exit code: -4058. Process output: npm warn Unknown env config "min-release-age". This will stop working in the next major version of npm. npm error code ENOENT npm error syscall open npm error path C:\Users\xxx\AppData\Local\JetBrains\IntelliJIdea2026.1\acp-agents\.runtimes\node\24.13.0\npm-cache\_npx\6722ddab116cb282\package.json npm error errno -4058</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">错误日志如上，idea提示我：</span></strong></p>
<p>The agent runtime may be corrupted. 清除已下载的 ACP 运行时 and try again in the new chat.</p>
<p>If the issue persists, close the IDE, delete the C:\Users\xxx\AppData\Local\JetBrains\IntelliJIdea2026.1\acp-agents\.runtimes directory, and restart.The agent runtime may be corrupted. 清除已下载的 ACP 运行时 and try again in the new chat.</p>
<p>按照他说的没用，还是缺少<strong>package.json。</strong>好在之前处理管理后台，需要webpack打包，研究了node，不然还不知道怎么办。</p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>解决办法</strong>：缺什么自己补什么，我发现这个目录<strong>acp-agents\.runtimes\node\24.13.0\npm-cache\_npx\6722ddab116cb282\，</strong>已经下载好了node_modules，只是缺少package.json，不知道是因为网络墙的原因还是啥，反正可以自己补上，根据node_modules文件夹里面有哪些package给自己生成一个package.json出来，问了ai：node如何根据已经存在的node_modules，逆向生成package.json，他给我了一段代码：</p>
<hr>
<p>const fs = require('fs');<br>const path = require('path');</p>
<p>const nodeModulesDir = path.join(__dirname, 'node_modules');<br>const dependencies = {};</p>
<p>function scan(dir) {<br>  const items = fs.readdirSync(dir);<br>  items.forEach(item =&gt; {<br>    // 处理 @scope 目录<br>    if (item.startsWith('@')) {<br>      const scopeDir = path.join(dir, item);<br>      if (fs.statSync(scopeDir).isDirectory()) {<br>        const subItems = fs.readdirSync(scopeDir);<br>        subItems.forEach(sub =&gt; {<br>          const pkgPath = path.join(scopeDir, sub, 'package.json');<br>          if (fs.existsSync(pkgPath)) {<br>            const { name, version } = require(pkgPath);<br>            dependencies[name] = version;<br>          }<br>        });<br>      }<br>    } else {<br>      const fullPath = path.join(dir, item);<br>      // 过滤掉非目录文件（如 .bin, .package-lock.json）<br>      if (fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory()) {<br>        const pkgPath = path.join(fullPath, 'package.json');<br>        if (fs.existsSync(pkgPath)) {<br>          const { name, version } = require(pkgPath);<br>          dependencies[name] = version;<br>        }<br>      }<br>    }<br>  });<br>}</p>
<p>scan(nodeModulesDir);</p>
<p>const packageJson = {<br>  name: "recovered-project",<br>  version: "1.0.0",<br>  description: "Recovered from node_modules",<br>  main: "index.js",<br>  scripts: { test: "echo \"Error: no test specified\" &amp;&amp; exit 1" },<br>  dependencies,<br>  devDependencies: {}<br>};</p>
<p>fs.writeFileSync(<br>  path.join(__dirname, 'package.json'),<br>  JSON.stringify(packageJson, null, 2)<br>);</p>
<p>console.log(`✅ package.json 已生成，包含 ${Object.keys(dependencies).length} 个依赖`);</p>
<hr>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>我们将上述代码复制，在目录<strong>acp-agents\.runtimes\node\24.13.0\npm-cache\_npx\6722ddab116cb282\</strong>下新建一个空白文件gen-package.js，然后将复制的内容粘贴进去，使用cmd在当前目录执行命令：node gen-package.js，就会生成package.json。该问题解决。如果你电脑本身没有安装全局性的node.js，那你就调用C:\Users\xxxAppData\Local\JetBrains\IntelliJIdea2026.1\acp-agents\.runtimes\node\24.13.0\bin目录下的node.exe，这个node和你全局安装的node不一样，此处的node是idea自己的ai chat安装的。<strong><br></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>问题2、</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Reconnecting... 1/5</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Reconnecting... 2/5</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Reconnecting... 3/5</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Reconnecting... 4/5</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Reconnecting... 5/5</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">&nbsp;</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">unexpected status 503 Service Unavailable: Unknown error, url: http://127.0.0.1:50000/responses</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>解决办法：</strong>当你看到http://127.0.0.1:xxxx/responses, 就知道，这肯定是走了代理，可是我明明用了vpn开了全局的，diea的设置里面http代理也是设置的自动检测代理，为什么ai没走我的系统代理？原因是他自己会新建一个代理走，但是咱们属于国内，走他那个代理，相当于不会翻出去，也就网络不通。所以咱们要修改codex的代理，C:\Users\xxx\.codex\目录下，有个.env文件，如果没有就自己新建，然后将以下内容复制进去，然后重启idea，问题解决。<strong><strong>（注意：下面的1081是你自己的系统代理的端口号，改成自己的！！！）</strong></strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>HTTP_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:1081"<br>HTTPS_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:1081"<br>NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1,::1"</p>
<hr>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
